description: This file defines the MessagePath interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package. It represents the 'path' field of Ditto protocol messages and provides methods to retrieve feature IDs and message direction, as well as static utility methods for JSON key conversions related to message direction.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Retrieves the feature ID if present in the message path.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the message direction (inbox or outbox) if specified.

methods.name: jsonKeyToDirection
methods.description: Converts a JsonKey to a MessageDirection based on its string value.

methods.name: directionToJsonKey
methods.description: Converts a MessageDirection to its corresponding JsonKey.
